primary: Reuse existing DST25 V1/V5/V6/V7 fits, measured Q25 and independent OCV25 unchanged at 0,10,40,50C; no target refitting in primary criterion.
diagnostic: For each target temperature fit V6 only on that temperature's DST; evaluate FUDS/US06 at the same temperature without additional fitting.
diagnostic_model: V6_local uses the same fixed OCV_mean25 and measured Q25 reference as transferred V6. Fit RC, Qratio in [0.9,1.1] and z0 in [0.9,1.0] with identical three starts, tau<=3600s and optimizer from lfp_static_protocol.json.
temperature_OCV: Read low-current target-temperature charge/discharge, measure capacity and plot OCV for diagnostic characterization only; neither primary nor local V6 substitutes these OCV/Q values.
initial_state: Same A1-007, verify CCCV preparation for each profile; original z0=1; RC initial zero. No target voltage inversion. Reconstruct SOC from trapezoidal canonical-current integration, same 1s continuous simulator.
recovery: (MAE_V6_transferred-MAE_V6_local)/MAE_V6_transferred; additionally (MAE_V1-MAE_V6_local)/MAE_V1. Signed, not clipped; zero denominators explicitly unavailable. Not an oracle ceiling.
criterion_exclusion: V6_local is excluded from every primary model choice, temperature pass flag and thermal verdict.
preservation: Keep all earlier results including blocked thermal artifacts and original report_static_replication.md byte-identical. Completed run in results/lfp_static_temperature/cell_A_a123; write report_static_temperature.md.
missing_or_mismatched_cell: Stop rather than substitute A1-008 or another temperature.
